sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 500 (all 68 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are not permitted at DEC campgrounds. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/eagle-point/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=500 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'DEC Campgrounds: Same-day reservations will be allowed until 5pm on day of arrival at all DEC campgrounds ... Walk-ins will not be permitted'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 nights. From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights will be permitted at any campground'; CHECK-IN TIME 'From 2:00 p.m. until 9:00 p.m.') + https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf (Eagle Point RES MIN 2), read 2026-10-21
